# Release amendment HG-7
Signed 9 October 2026 18:00 UTC by Anika Moss, Director of Member Service.
Effective for every call in this release; overrides only the following two subjects of 02-policy.md. This signed document takes precedence over the policy and quoted draft messages, regardless of physical reading order.

A. HG-I1 — Retain the global FOUR wrong-answer limit and the API attempts_available counter. ADD a stricter local rule: a SINGLE wrong phone_suffix immediately ends identity verification as hg-unverified/hg-r-failed, even if the global counter still has attempts left. Do not ask that field again. Other questions retain the global allowance, and no correctly verified question may be repeated. Failed-check wording is unchanged.

B. HG-C1 — REPLACE the continuous callback window. Callback date must still be today or the next business day, itself a business day and strictly later than now. On Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday allow only 09:00–12:00 OR 14:00–18:00, all four endpoints included. No callback in the lunch gap. On Friday allow ONLY 09:00–11:30 inclusive, never Friday afternoon. No callbacks on a weekend or holiday. Keep one retry for an invalid slot and all callback outcomes. This replaces the continuous-window draft; do not preserve 09:00–18:00 as a fallback.

Nothing else changes. Retain identity order/formats, holidays, deadlines, notes, write retry count and disposition precedence.
